## Adding or changing an app

- [ ] One file: `registry/apps/<id>.json` (id = filename, lowercase-with-dashes)
- [ ] Installs from an **official Arch repo**, the **AUR**, or an **`omarchy install …`** command — no curl scripts, no custom shell
- [ ] AUR packages: active maintainer, not flagged out of date, reasonable vote count
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build.py --check` passes locally

## Anything else

Describe what changed and why.
